summary: Pin plate-core to gh-plate tag version (#614): launcher reads VERSION/PLATE_CORE_VERSION (or env), installs/reinstalls plate-core==X.Y.Z; monorepo dev checkout skips pin; publish workflow writes PLATE_CORE_VERSION marker.
migration_impact: After upgrade, `gh plate` from the thin extension enforces matching plate-core. Dev monorepo runs unchanged unless PLATE_CORE_FORCE_PIN=1. Requires PyPI plate-core publish for each tag for pin to resolve.
migration_guidance: 2. Ensure plate-core==X.Y.Z is published on PyPI for each gh-plate tag (human Task #626 if blocked).
3. Fresh install: gh extension install akasper/gh-plate@vX.Y.Z should auto-install matching plate-core.
4. Override pin only with PLATE_CORE_VERSION env or PLATE_CORE_FORCE_PIN for diagnostics.
